name: ElevenAgents (ElevenLabs Agents Platform)
summary: ElevenLabs' hosted platform for voice and multimodal agents: ASR, any LLM, 10,000+ voices and a turn-taking model, with workflows, tools, telephony, tests and evals.
description: Coordinates a fine-tuned speech-to-text model, your choice of LLM (or a custom one), low-latency TTS and a proprietary turn-taking model; agents can alternatively run on ElevenLabs Realtime speech-to-speech models, which are OpenAI Realtime-compatible. Build with the dashboard, visual workflow builder, CLI (agents as code) or a hosted MCP server; deploy via web widget, React/Swift/Kotlin/React Native SDKs, WebSocket API, SIP trunk, Twilio or batch outbound calls; monitor with testing, A/B experiments, conversation analysis and analytics. Pricing (as of 2026-10-23): Free plan with 15 call minutes and 4 concurrent calls; paid plans from $6/month; additional minutes $0.08, LLM and telephony billed at cost. Docs ship llms.txt and llms-full.txt.

agent_access.notes: ElevenLabs API key (xi-api-key header) for the API, CLI and SDKs.
